question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The solution is **Milennium**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• the INCORRECTLY spelt word is Milennium.
 
• The correct spelt word is Millennium.
 
• **Millennium - **A period of a thousand years, especially when calculated from the traditional date of the birth of Christ.
 
 
• *For example : "Silver first came into use on a substantial scale during the 3rd millennium bc."*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Inoculate - **Immunize (someone) against a disease by introducing infective material, microorganisms, or vaccine into the body.

 
 
• *For example : "The country will have enough vaccine stockpiled to inoculate the entire population."***​**
 
 
 
• **Leisure - **Time when one is not working or occupied or free time.** **
 
 
• ​*For example : "People with too much enforced leisure."*​
 
 
 
• **Medieval - **Relating to the Middle Ages.
 
 
• ​*For example : "A medieval castle."*​
